We need produce heat_advisory JSON. Choose up to 8 actions suitable for ORANGE days. Pick most important: COMMS_PUBLIC_ANNOUNCE_ORANGE_RED, IMD_ORANGE_ADVICE, IMD_ORANGE_ORS_FLUIDS, NDMA_ORANGE_AVOID_EXPOSURE_HYDRATE, NAP_HOSP_AMBULANCE_ICE_PACKS_COLD_WATER, MUNI_WATER_TANKERS_SLUMS, SCHOOL_RESCHEDULE_TIMINGS, HEALTH_WEEKLY_IMPACT_REPORT. That's 8.

Now day sentences: each one short, include forecast max maybe rounded. Use only that day's colour name. For ORANGE days, mention orange. For green day, mention green. No other colours.

Day1: 2022-04-28 forecast max 42.4°C, orange. Sentence: "Thursday 28 April will see orange alert with a maximum of about 42°C." Use rounding to whole numbers maybe 42°C.

Day2 similar.

Day5 green: "Monday 2 May will have a green alert with a maximum of about 42°C."

Summary: 2-3 sentences: mention highest alert level orange on which days (Thursday to Sunday) and what to watch. Include colours that occur: orange and green. No other colours. Sentence: "Orange alert is expected Thursday through Sunday; watch for high temperatures and heat stress." Second sentence maybe: "Monday will be green with slightly lower risk." Ensure no extra colours.

Return JSON.
